name: text-blur-random-in
title: Random Blur In
description: Các ký tự rõ dần từ vùng nhoè 20 px theo thứ tự ngẫu nhiên, như sương tan.

moworks.author: moworks

options.gap: [min, max] s between letters, 1 s / (n − 1) clamped ([0.05, 0.14])

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Codrops (MIT); a faithful port of Codrops' effects is in the Codrops collection

moworks.notes: Split chars, seeded random order; each char opacity 0 → 1 and blur 20 → 0 px, 0.6 s power1.inOut (easeInOutQuad, CSS cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1)), 50 ms apart (demo 1 s/(n−1) clamped 50–140 ms) from 0.3 s. The source is scroll-scrubbed (top bottom → center center); here it runs on time. Loop exit: fade 2.45–2.75 s; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.6 s) · stagger: ngẫu nhiên (0.05 s) · blur (20 px) · seed. Scroll-scrubbed in the source; here it runs on the film's clock.
